root_cause.text: The TID value obtained from ieee80211_get_tid() is used directly as an index into the sta_entry->tids[] array without a bounds check, allowing an out-of-bounds array access when the TID is equal to or greater than MAX_TID_COUNT.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (tid < MAX_TID_COUNT)` before accessing `sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state`. The UBSAN report confirms an array-index-out-of-bounds error with index 10 on an array of size 9 (`rtl_tid_data [9]`).
